content.short: Stryke (formerly Dopex) is a decentralized options exchange on Mantle offering Single Staking Option Vaults and permissionless non-custodial options markets.
content.description: Stryke, originally known as Dopex, is one of DeFi's leading options protocols offering a range of products including Single Staking Option Vaults (SSOVs), Atlantic Options, and perpetual options with a mechanism design that minimizes losses for option writers while maximizing liquidity for buyers. The protocol has been operating since 2021 and rebranded to Stryke to reflect its expanded product suite. Deployed on Mantle, Stryke brings sophisticated on-chain options trading to the network's derivatives ecosystem.
content.meta: Stryke is a decentralized options exchange on Mantle offering non-custodial options trading products. Discover Stryke on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
